default.about: The repository's model configuration as it stands: default profile mistral-small (overflow luna), level of detail off, lessons off.

luna.about: The subject thinks with GPT-6 Luna through the carlid endpoint (overflow mistral-small); otherwise as default.

lessons.about: Default profile with LIVING_LESSONS=1: consolidation keeps, with a memory, what it taught.

grounds.about: Default profile with LIVING_GROUNDS=1: recall follows GROUNDS edges between stories and beliefs.

lod.about: Default profile with LIVING_LOD=1: no player is on stage, so deliberations wait LIVING_LOD_THINK_S unless urgent.
